verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents generating API credentials under Settings > Access Management > API Credentials. The same screen lets you configure each credential's permissions and an optional expiry date, which supports issuing scoped, time-limited credentials for an agent. missing for 10: documentation of permission granularity (which scopes or resources can be restricted), agent- or service-account-specific credential guidance, programmatic credential issuance or rotation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
